verdicts.decision_note: The client requires every article layout to render the author name and a small circular author photograph; administrative launch dates were correctly excluded.
The client establishes a smaller rendered size for the author-attribution presentation, adding a concrete layout acceptance condition without making prior keys obsolete.
First concrete size failure: the client reports that the author-attribution presentation in the reviewed layout is too large.
The client identifies the source that must supply the correct author photographs, changing the layout's asset-selection rule without invalidating an existing key.
Distinct identity failure: the client observes that the reviewed article uses the wrong author photograph.
The client specifies that the rendered author name and photograph follow the article title and category label, establishing a concrete placement rule.
